mapper.update: UPDATE T_CLIENT_ERROR SET CNT = CNT + 1 ,LAST_DAY = NOW() ,PATH = COALESCE(#{path,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, PATH) ,UA = COALESCE(#{ua,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, UA) ,STATUS = CASE WHEN STATUS = 'DONE' THEN 'OPEN' ELSE STATUS END WHERE SIG = #{sig}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T_CLIENT_ERROR (SIG, KIND, MESSAGE, STACK, PATH, UA) VALUES (#{sig}, #{kind}, #{message}, #{stack,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{path,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{ua,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) ON CONFLICT (SIG) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM T_CLIENT_ERROR WHERE FIRST_DAY >= NOW() - INTERVAL '1 day'
SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE STATUS = 'OPEN')::INT AS "open" ,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE STATUS = 'DONE')::INT AS "done" ,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE STATUS = 'IGNORED')::INT AS "ignored" FROM T_CLIENT_ERROR
mapper.update: UPDATE T_CLIENT_ERROR SET STATUS = #{status} WHERE ID = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT E.SIG AS "sig" ,E.KIND AS "kind" ,E.MESSAGE AS "message" ,E.STACK AS "stack" ,E.PATH AS "path" ,E.CNT AS "cnt" FROM T_CLIENT_ERROR E WHERE 1=1 AND E.STATUS = 'OPEN' AND E.KIND <> 'CHUNK' AND E.CNT >= 2 AND E.LAST_DAY >= NOW() - INTERVAL '2 days' ORDER BY E.CNT DESC LIMIT 5
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM T_CLIENT_ERROR WHERE LAST_DAY < NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
